root_cause.text: The XFRM per-net `policy_hthresh.work` work item was not synchronized or canceled during `xfrm_policy_fini()` netns teardown, allowing `xfrm_hash_rebuild()` to run after the enclosing `struct net` had been freed and dereference stale memory via `container_of()`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit explicitly states that `XFRM_MSG_NEWSPDINFO` can queue `policy_hthresh.work`, that `xfrm_hash_rebuild()` gets `struct net` from the work item with `container_of()`, and that teardown previously only flushed `policy_hash_work`; the patch fixes this by adding `disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work);` in `xfrm_policy_fini()`.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE/commit explicitly states that `XFRM_MSG_NEWSPDINFO` can queue `policy_hthresh.work`, that `xfrm_hash_rebuild()` gets `struct net` from the work item with `container_of()`, and that teardown previously only flushed `policy_hash_work`; the patch fixes this by adding `disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work);` in `xfrm_policy_fini()`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Disable and synchronize pending policy_hthresh work during XFRM policy teardown to prevent races with cleanup.
intent_record.what: A call to disable_work_sync(&net->xfrm.policy_hthresh.work); was added at the start of xfrm_policy_fini(struct net *net), immediately before the existing flush_work(&net->xfrm.policy_hash_work); call.
intent_record.how: This synchronously disables the policy_hthresh work item during XFRM policy teardown so it cannot be queued or run while finalization is in progress, reducing the chance of concurrent work execution against cleanup state and preventing teardown races or use-after-free conditions.

grouping_result.intent: Disable and synchronize pending policy_hthresh work during XFRM policy teardown to prevent races with cleanup.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by disabling and synchronizing the per-net policy_hthresh.work during XFRM policy teardown, preventing xfrm_hash_rebuild() from running after netns cleanup and dereferencing freed struct net memory.

candidates.rationale: Teardown synchronized only policy_hash_work, but not the separate policy_hthresh.work item described in the root cause. This incomplete synchronization in xfrm_policy_fini() allowed policy_hthresh.work to remain pending and later execute after netns memory was freed.

vuln_statements.explanation: During xfrm_policy_fini() teardown, this synchronization covered only policy_hash_work and omitted the separate policy_hthresh.work item. Because the per-net policy_hthresh work was neither canceled nor flushed, it could execute after the enclosing struct net was freed, leading xfrm_hash_rebuild() to dereference stale memory via container_of().
